Having skipped breakfast and with noon already upon us, we decide to begin with lunch.

Saber cannot assume spirit form like Archer, and receives none of the magical energy a Servant should ordinarily receive from her Master.

Both failures are, of course, the result of my own inexperience as a Master.

Sleep can apparently prevent further expenditure of magical energy, but it cannot fully replenish what she has lost.

That leaves food as her only source of energy. As the one responsible for our meals, I cannot afford to cut corners.

pages.en:
“Servants use magical energy to maintain physical form, right?

“Then if your magical energy can’t recover… does that mean you’ll grow weaker with every battle?”

After putting away the dishes, I ask while folding my apron.

「まったく回復しない、という訳ではありません。
魔力というものは活動している内は絶え間なく生成されるものです。自然からの供給がないサーヴァントでも、自身の魔術回路だけで少なからず魔力を補充する事は出来ます」
「なんだ。なら問題はないんじゃないのか？」

pages.en:
“It is not that I cannot recover at all.

“Magical energy is generated without pause while one remains alive. Even a Servant cut off from an external supply can replenish a small quantity through her own Magic Circuits.”

“Then there’s no problem, is there?”

“You see the drops of water falling from it? Think of those as the quantity of magical energy I generate myself. The glass catching them is my body.

“In my present condition, magical energy will accumulate within me, though only a little at a time.”

“Now, the more the water weighs down the glass, the farther the faucet opens.

“So long as there is weight in the glass—water—the faucet continues to run. But when the glass is emptied, when I exhaust all the magical energy stored within me, the faucet closes completely.”

“The supply of magical energy then ceases, and the glass remains dry forever.

“—For a Servant, that is extinction.

“It may occur if one suffers wounds too severe to maintain the body, or can no longer retain enough magical energy to sustain oneself. …Though the latter case is exceedingly rare.”

“That is correct. But the water in the glass is also being consumed constantly.

“It is expended even as we sit here, and combat causes the rate of consumption to rise sharply.

“…Conversely, the more powerful an action, the more water it consumes. If I were to use my Noble Phantasm, even a full glass might be emptied in an instant.”

pages.en:
…This is growing complicated.

In short, because the faucet that should connect Saber to me is shut, she recovers magical energy at an appallingly slow rate—no more than a few falling drops.

If a battle begins, she must end it quickly. Afterward she must sleep for a long time, eliminating every unnecessary activity while the drops collect in her glass again.

Since last night, events have carried me along like a roller coaster. A single word from this woman flips the entire world upside down and turns it back into ordinary life.

It is uncanny.

The phrase is *swallowing your pride*, not *weathering your shame*. If Fuji is already weathering hers, she must be in the middle of some minor emergency.

“Yes. Though it should not surprise you, Shirou. Rin is in your year, is she not? A mage of her caliber has occupied this place for more than a year. She will surely have prepared at least one workshop, and no concealment could prevent all magical energy from escaping.”

Apparently, what Saber senses is something like Tohsaka’s lingering scent.

pages.ja: 「ふーん。あいつも結構ドジなんだな。入る前からセイバーに魔力感知されるなんて。……って、あいつ中にいるのか、今！？」
pages.jaRuby: 「ふーん。あいつも結構ドジなんだな。入る前からセイバーに魔力感知されるなんて。……って、あいつ中にいるのか、今！？」
pages.en: “Hmm. So she can be pretty careless too. Letting Saber sense her magical energy before we even enter… Wait, is she inside right now!?”

pages.ja:
「いいえ、凛本人はいないようです。彼女がいるのならもっと強く感じ取れるでしょう。この敷地には魔術師らしき人間はいない。
……気になる違和感はありますが、とりあえず危険はありません」

pages.en:
“No. Rin herself does not appear to be present. Were she here, I would sense a far stronger presence. There is no one resembling a mage within these grounds.

“…I do feel a troubling incongruity, but there is no immediate danger.”

pages.ja: 「だから危険なんてないって言っただろ。ほら、中に入るからちゃんと付いてこいよ」
pages.jaRuby: 「だから危険なんてないって言っただろ。ほら、中に入るからちゃんと付いてこいよ」
pages.en: “I told you it was safe. Come on, we’re going in. Stay close.”

」

弓道部主将・美綴綾子は俺の顔を見ただけで、その用件まで看破したらしい。

“————”

Someone who knows you well can be useful at times like this.

Ayako Mitsuzuri, captain of the archery club, has apparently deduced my entire purpose from one glance at my face.

pages.ja: 「お疲れ。お察しの通り飯を届けに来た。藤ねえは中に居るか？」
pages.jaRuby: 「お疲れ。お察しの通り飯を届けに来た。藤ねえは中に居るか？」
pages.en: “Good work. You guessed it. I brought food. Is Fuji inside?”

pages.ja: 「いるいる。いやあ、助かった。藤村先生ったら空腹でテンション高くて困ってたのよ。学食も休みだしさ、仕方ないんで買い出しに行こうかって考えあぐねてたところ」

pages.en: “She is, she is. You saved us. Ms. Fujimura was getting hyper from hunger, and none of us knew what to do with her. The cafeteria’s closed, so we were just wondering whether we’d have to send someone shopping.”

pages.ja:
「そこまで深刻だったか。で、買い出しって、まさか下のトヨエツに一人でか？」
「そこ以外に何処があるって言うのよ。ただでさえ備品で金食ってるんだから、非常食に金はさけないでしょ」

pages.en:
“It was that serious? And by shopping, you don’t mean sending someone down to Toyoetsu alone?”

“Where else would we go? Equipment already eats enough of our budget. We can’t waste money stocking emergency food.”

pages.ja:
さすが美綴、無駄遣いを嫌う女。
ちなみにトヨエツとは商店街にあるスーパーの名前である。
弓道部では、腕の筋肉を休めている暇人が走り込みと称して買い出しに行かされる。
……腕を休める為の走りこみだっていうのに、帰りには大量の荷物を持たされるという矛盾した習慣だ。

pages.en:
That is Mitsuzuri for you—a woman who despises waste.

Toyoetsu, incidentally, is the supermarket in the shopping district.

At the archery club, anyone idle enough to be resting their arms is sent to buy supplies under the pretext of a training run.

…It is a wonderfully contradictory custom: a run meant to rest the arms ends with the runner carrying an enormous load home.

pages.ja:
「……そりゃ災難だったな。ほら弁当。遅くなったけど、藤ねえに渡してやってくれ」
ほら、と紙袋を差し出す。

「……そりゃ災難だったな。ほら弁当。遅くなったけど、藤ねえに渡してやってくれ」
ほら、と紙袋を差し出す。
pages.en:
“…That would’ve been rough. Here’s the lunch. It’s late, but give it to Fuji for me.”

I hold out the paper bag.

pages.ja:
「お、豪華三段セット。いいね、久しぶりに見た。衛宮はこういう細いの上手なのよね」
何が嬉しいのか、にんまりと笑う美綴。
pages.jaRuby:
「お、豪華三段セット。いいね、久しぶりに見た。衛宮はこういう[ruby text=こま]細いの上手なのよね」
何が嬉しいのか、にんまりと笑う美綴。
pages.en:
“Oh, a deluxe three-tier set. Nice. I haven’t seen one of these in ages. You’ve always been good at fiddly little things like this, Emiya.”

For some reason, Mitsuzuri grins broadly.

pages.ja:
……そういうコイツは、とにかく大量生産に優れている。
合宿の夕食はたいてい美綴が担当し、その都度みんなを驚かせたものだ。
皮しか剥いていないじゃがいもカレーが美味かったあたり、料理の世界は奥が深い。

pages.en:
…She, on the other hand, excels at producing food in enormous quantities.

Mitsuzuri usually handles dinner during training camps, and every time she manages to astonish everyone.

Her potato curry—made from potatoes she had done nothing but peel—was somehow delicious. The culinary arts are deep indeed.

pages.ja:
……いやまあ、それはいいとして。
美綴は中を覗いただけで、紙袋を受け取りはしなかった。

pages.en:
…Well, never mind that.

Mitsuzuri has looked inside the bag, but makes no move to accept it.

pages.jaRuby: 「おい。嫌味はいいから受け取れ。中、藤ねえが暴れててタイヘンなんじゃないのか」
pages.en: “Hey. Enough sarcasm. Take it. Isn’t Fuji rampaging in there?”

pages.ja:
「そうね。そう思うんならさっさと中に入って、藤村先生に手渡してあげるべし。
だいたいね、入り口でアンタを帰したなんて言ったらもっとへそ曲げるに決まってるじゃない。あたしは藤村先生にしごかれたくはないからね。ほら、ここまで来たら観念して中に入りな」
くい、とあごで道場を指す。

くい、とあごで道場を指す。
pages.en:
“Yes. And if you think so, march inside and give it to Ms. Fujimura yourself.

“If I tell her I turned you away at the door, she’ll sulk even harder. I have no desire to be worked to death by Ms. Fujimura. Come on—you’ve made it this far, so accept your fate and go inside.”

She gestures toward the dojo with her chin.

pages.ja:
「……………………」
たしかに、成り行き上顔ぐらい出しておかないと後が怖い。
別に弓を持ちに来た訳じゃなし、弁当を渡したらとっとと帰ればいいだけか。

pages.en:
“……………………”

Given how matters have developed, failing to show my face would only frighten me later.

It is not as though I came to practice. I can hand over the lunch and leave immediately.

pages.ja:
仕方ないな、と観念して弓道場に足を運ぶ。
「けどな美綴。おまえも長いんだから、朝のうちに藤ねえの弁当ぐらい確認しとけよ。顧問が生徒の昼飯を物欲しそうに見て回る、なんてイメージ悪すぎるぞ」

pages.en:
Resigned, I head toward the archery range.

“But Mitsuzuri, you’ve been doing this long enough to check whether Fuji brought lunch in the morning. The club advisor wandering around covetously inspecting her students’ lunches is terrible for the club’s reputation.”

pages.ja:
「いや、それがあたしも今朝は疲れててさ。最近ちょっと忙しくて、あんまり余裕がないんだな。ま、アンタに愚痴ってもしょうがないんだけど
」

」
pages.en: “I was tired this morning too. Things have been a little hectic lately, and I haven’t had much breathing room. Not that complaining to you will help—”

pages.ja:
と、唐突に体を寄せると、内緒話でもするかのように耳元に近づいて、
「……で、衛宮。あれ何者よ。凄い美人だけど、知り合い？」
なんて、緊張しきった声で言ってきた。

pages.en:
Abruptly, she leans close and brings her mouth to my ear as though sharing a secret.

“…So, Emiya. Who is that? She’s incredibly beautiful. Someone you know?”

Her voice is wound tight with tension.

“————”

Of course… Any ordinary person would be startled by Saber.

All the more when she is silently following me into the archery range.

pages.en:
“Well, Emiya? Do you know her?”

“It would be complicated to explain, but I’d be grateful if you assumed I did. …And if you could tell everyone not to make a fuss when she enters the clubroom, I’d owe you more than I can say.”

pages.ja:
「……………オッケー。事情は気になるけど、その交換条件は気に入った。衛宮、あとでチャラってのはなしだからね」
扉を開ける。
セイバーは無言で、俺と美綴の後に付いてきた。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“……………All right. I want the story, but I like the terms of that trade. Don’t try telling me later that we’re even, Emiya.”

She opens the door.

Saber follows Mitsuzuri and me inside without a word.

pages.en:
We enter the dojo.

…After the lunch break, the archery range is as noisy as a battlefield.

“Hey, you! Don't press down from above when you string it. You're still young—if it's too difficult, have two people do it. If the bow flips over and the tip slips free, it'll break your neck.

“Like this—snap. I mean *I’ll* break the neck of the student who damages a valuable bow.”

“Ms. Fujimura! We’re out of grip powder! My hand—my hand keeps slipping!”

“What, really? Someone go to the storeroom and bring out the reserve stock!”

“Ms. Fujimura, there is no reserve stock! We believe the cause was your forgetting to place the order the other day!”

“Oh. Then the first-years can steal a rosin bag from the baseball club!”

“This teacher has gone completely lawless!”

いや。
ホント、変わらないなここの光景。
pages.jaRuby:

“……………………”

No.

The scene here truly never changes.

pages.en:
“—All right.”

I cannot stand here forever watching this screaming chaos.

I call to the girl standing before the rack of gloves.

“Shirou…!?”

Sakura sets down her bow and runs over, eyes wide with confusion.

“I brought Fuji lunch. Never mind that—could you bring over the teacher shouting nonsense?”

“Ah—yes. Of course. …Now that you mention it, Ms. Fujimura did make a phone call.”

Her earlier smile vanishes, and Sakura’s shoulders droop.

pages.en:
“That’s right. Fuji is making impossible demands because she’s hungry, isn’t she? It may already be too late, but I made lunch, so see that she eats it.

“And I’m sorry I was late yesterday. Thanks for making dinner.”

“…Um, Shirou?”

“No, not at all! I-I’m hungry too…! …I gave Ms. Fujimura half of mine.”

pages.en: “Y-yes, that’s true. Then I’ll gladly eat it… Shirou, will you be staying at the dojo all day?”

pages.en: “I think so. I came all this way, so I’ll stay at school until the club finishes. I skipped yesterday, and I’ll cook dinner tonight, so come eat with us, Sakura.”

Fuji sips tea and nibbles sweet bean jelly for dessert.

Perhaps because she has finally quieted down, only the gentle hum of bowstrings and the hiss of arrows now sound through the dojo.

“Ms. Fujimura. I should return to the range now, so please excuse me.”

“All right. Oh, would you tell Mitsuzuri, the one waiting outside, that I need to speak with her?”

Sakura bows and leaves.

But as she goes,

she casts an uneasy glance at Saber, who is quietly observing from beside the wall.
